description: See your usage grouped by pricing function: calls, spend and outcomes for each function over a period. Pass start_date and end_date to choose the period, and group_by function, the only grouping there is. Read-only. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

end_date.description: The end of the period, as an ISO 8601 date and time.

group_by.description: How to group. Only function is available.

start_date.description: The start of the period, as an ISO 8601 date and time.

name: get_usage_breakdown
